openings.claim: Relocate evidence-ledger support into manifest-indexed stage-graph edges in a local script's report. Each edge carries record identifiers, comparable digest states and uncertainty; missing support blocks a definite claim. The analyst still verifies comparability, selects next checks and owns conclusions.
openings.delta: Removed transform record → empty manifest slot → support-invalid edge → recomputed unresolved interval and a next check against remaining supplied records. This converts deletion into a control signal rather than assuming nonexecution. Graph maintenance requires manifest/dictionary mapping, identifier validation and inspection logging; these burdens remain within analyst time.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, an ordinary claim/record ledger with manual final rereading, this report should visibly retract claims whose sole support was removed and expose affected intervals. Both may reach identical conclusions; no accuracy or time gain is established. Matching ingest digests establish recorded equality only; an export mismatch with unavailable transform support does not establish transform divergence.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes, prepare both variants and baseline outputs for the six pairs, logging at most twelve manual inspections per pair across all passes. Use the disjoint three-pair subsets for the variants, freeze baseline outputs, apply the stipulated deletions, then freeze final outputs before opening the two answer sheets. Spend the additional twenty minutes comparing supported boundaries, intervals and unsupported claims. Separately check whether restoring the removed records cancels gap signals. Blank warnings and reversed timestamps must not falsely trigger record-absence signals. Subset differences confound between-variant comparisons; emphasize each variant's before/after behavior.
assumptions: Dictionary and manifest permit artifact-boundary matching; otherwise retain uncertainty.
Expected stage order guides graph layout, not proof of actual execution chronology; timestamp conflict remains an observed mismatch, with explanation unresolved.

Defeat conditions: incomplete manifest mapping, unsupported comparability, deletion of redundant support producing no changed conclusion, or insufficient setup time. Report these limits; a time cap alone cannot validate the probe.

assessment: One bounded workflow hypothesis. Automatic propagation supplements manual judgment; probe results remain synthetic and do not authorize deployment or live-system claims.
